package.scope: Third integration smoke package; later source changes are not covered by this artifact check.

execution.operator: root agent through actual native Windows UI
execution.review: Independent read-only inspection of ten saved screenshots and bounded process/server records; reviewer did not launch, focus, close or stop any process.

execution.credentialHandling: Only a synthetic imported key in the GUI fixture; original import file and encrypted profile contents were not read for this audit. Root reports normal DPAPI storage; masked field and import success were visually verified.

One synthetic provider key imported through the native file-dialog flow; DeepSeek provider card appears and status reports one imported key. No real DeepSeek service request was made by this fixture.
Local loopback provider dialog shows model context limit32768 and a masked key field.
Composer contains typed synthetic request and blue enabled Send button.
Native transcript displays fixture reasoning while Stop is visible.
Completed synthetic response remains visible beside native embedded loopback page ONE.
Ordinary browser tabs ONE and TWO visible before idle titlebar close.
Relaunched packaged app restored ONE and TWO with TWO selected; server observed TWO load again.
Held stream remains busy with Stop visible; browser address bar accepts unsubmitted input while stream is active. Operator then closed the native titlebar.

serverEvidence.scope: Loopback HTTP fixture, not an external provider or arbitrary internet website.

nativeClose.action: Native Windows titlebar X, operator observed; separate process-wrapper records confirm exit.
nativeClose.timingLimit: Process records do not timestamp the X click; no exact click-to-exit latency is claimed. Busy request receipt to process exit was under the90-second fixture hold. Child-process census was not part of these records.

separateLiveCodex.classification: Actual managed Codex model and native commandExecution, not synthetic GUI fixture
separateLiveCodex.provider: Codex installed native CLI, managed ChatGPT subscription
separateLiveCodex.scope: Actual packaged native AgentEngine+AgentToolHost, live managed Codex, one read-only turn. Hidden transcript renders; not main-window input, native mutation-journal coverage, or complete parity.
separateLiveCodex.initialFailure: Retained in local gallery and audit/codex-harness-native.json; command launcher failure resolved by filtering inherited parent desktop routing environment. No token extraction or global account changes.

screenshotsPublication: Private/local only. Public audit contains sanitized observations and hashes, no copied images, key material or chat history.
limits: This verifies the named packaged GUI scenarios, not complete Stagewise parity.
Synthetic streaming verifies UI and request lifecycle; it does not validate a real DeepSeek response or credential.
The separate real Codex success is one read-only turn rendered in a hidden transcript; it does not establish full-window Codex login/input, all models, or mutation journal parity.
Later transcript, picker and fallback lifecycle integration requires its own final build/test gate.
No click-to-process-exit latency or owned child-process termination count can be derived from these bounded records.
